pairs.target: tā méi shuō shì nǎ yìzhǒng .
pairs.english: He did not say which it was.
pairs.hanzi: 他没说是哪一种。

pairs.target: jìng lǐ de hóngsè bèi fēngchuī dé gǔqǐlái , yòu tāxiàqù , qiáoxià de kōnggǔ fǎngfú yě gēnzhe hūxī .
pairs.english: In the lens, the red cloth billowed and fell in the wind, and the empty valley beneath the bridge seemed to breathe with it.
pairs.hanzi: 镜里的红色被风吹得鼓起来，又塌下去，桥下的空谷仿佛也跟着呼吸。

pairs.target: láng hòulái le jǐgè rén , yígè gāogèzi xuéshēng tíxǐng tāmen háiyǒu rén děng .
pairs.english: Several people came from the corridor, and a tall student reminded them others were waiting.
pairs.hanzi: 廊后来了几个人，一个高个子学生提醒他们还有人等。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō mǎshàng , mǐlā yǐjīng bào qǐ mùhé .
pairs.english: Iven said, “Just a moment,” while Mira had already picked up her box.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说马上，米拉已经抱起木盒。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuìhòu kàn yìyǎn , jiāng dèngzǐ nuó huí yuánchù .
pairs.english: Tavi took one last look and moved the stool back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维最后看一眼，将凳子挪回原处。

pairs.target: zǒuchū xī láng , yīwén wèn tāmen zhù nǎ yuàn ,
pairs.english: Leaving the west corridor, Iven asked which courtyard they lived in,
pairs.hanzi: 走出西廊，伊文问他们住哪院，

pairs.target: shuō zìjǐ zài dōng yuàn dìèrpái , zǎochén zhǎo tīng cái shì zhǎodào le chúfáng .
pairs.english: saying he was in the east courtyard's second row and had found the kitchen while looking for the material-listening room that morning.
pairs.hanzi: 说自己在东院第二排，早晨找听材室找到了厨房。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō nánguài méi jiàn tā , suíhòu wèn chúfáng yǒuméiyǒu bǐ fàntáng hǎo de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Mira said that explained not seeing him, then asked whether the kitchen had anything better than the dining hall.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说难怪没见他，随后问厨房有没有比饭堂好的东西。

pairs.target: " yǒu . yǒurén zài qièròu . "
pairs.english: “Yes. Someone was cutting meat.”
pairs.hanzi: “有。有人在切肉。”

pairs.target: " zhè búsuàn . "
pairs.english: “That doesn't count.”
pairs.hanzi: “这不算。”

pairs.target: tāmen biān zǒu biān shuō , guò le yígè chàkǒu , cái fāxiàn sāngè rén shuí yě méi liúyì fāngxiàng .
pairs.english: They walked and talked past a junction before realizing none of the three had watched where they were going.
pairs.hanzi: 他们边走边说，过了一个岔口，才发现三个人谁也没留意方向。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū qiángjiǎo de shuǐgāng , zhuǎnshēn lǐng tāmen wǎnghuí zǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized the water jar in the corner and turned to lead them back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认出墙角的水缸，转身领他们往回走。

pairs.target: " zhèhuí wǒ zhīdào . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “This time I know,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “这回我知道。”他说。

pairs.target: yuǎnchù chuánlái bèi wǎnfàn de qiāo tǒng shēng .
pairs.english: From a distance came the sound of buckets being struck for supper preparations.
pairs.hanzi: 远处传来备晚饭的敲桶声。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ qiáo tú sāijìn yīdài , lù zài wàimiàn de zhǐ jiǎo bèi zhé huài le ,
pairs.english: Iven stuffed the bridge diagram in his pocket, crumpling the corner that stuck out;
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把桥图塞进衣袋，露在外面的纸角被折坏了，

pairs.target: tā shēnshǒu lǚ le yíxià , méi lǚ píng , yě méi zài guǎn .
pairs.english: he tried to smooth it, failed, and left it alone.
pairs.hanzi: 他伸手捋了一下，没捋平，也没再管。
